aria: Animated recap of the Suns' 111 to 101 road win over the Jazz: Devin Booker's layup with 3:14 left that made it 103 to 91, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Booker's 23 points, the top scorers, how the Suns won, and the next game.

figure.label: Devin Booker, listed 6-5, 206 lb, reported 6-8¼ wingspan

notes: Box score from the Suns' 111–101 road win over the Utah Jazz on Nov 20, 2026, from the Covers box score, checked line by line against StatMuse, with game details from the Associated Press (via CBS Sports and Yahoo Sports), Arizona Sports, The Sports Leader and SLC Dunk (via Yahoo Sports). All 111 Phoenix points and all 101 Utah points are accounted for in the box score, and the quarter scores (26–35–28–22 to 23–26–27–25) add up to both totals: 61–49 Phoenix at the half. Fast-break points (17–5), both biggest leads (Phoenix 16, Utah 2), assists (26–20) and Utah's 10 of 39 from three are from the box score; points off turnovers (19–9) and second-chance points (18–24) are from Arizona Sports. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Friday's games.

Phoenix won its third straight and moved over .500 for the first time this season; it has won 13 of its last 14 games against Utah (The Sports Leader; AP; Arizona Sports). The Jazz cut it to 96–89 with 6:25 left (AP). After Booker's layup made it 103–91, Dillon Brooks fouled out with 1:43 left and Utah's 9–0 run ended on Svi Mykhailiuk's three that made it 105–101 with 39.5 seconds left (AP; Arizona Sports). The Suns closed on a 6–0 run: Booker scored a basket and a free throw off a timeout play, a lay-in on a pass from Miles Bridges, and Jalen Green added a dunk and a free throw (AP; Arizona Sports). Rookie Darryn Peterson had his first career double-double for Utah (The Sports Leader). The Suns play at New Orleans on Monday, Nov 23 at 8:00 PM ET, the first meeting of the season (AP; Ball Exclusives).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Devin Booker's layup with 3:14 left that made it 103–91 (The Sports Leader: "A layup from Booker boosted the Suns' advantage to 103-91 with 3:14 remaining"; also GMA News). It was chosen over the clinching lay-in after Mykhailiuk's three because no source gives that basket's clock. It is drawn as a finish at the rim; the recaps don't describe the move. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Phoenix Suns or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The player in the play of the game is drawn to Devin Booker's listed 6-foot-5 and 206 pounds (Basketball-Reference; Wikipedia) with No. 15, the number he switched to for 2026-27 (Cronkite News), and his arms are scaled to a 6-foot-8¼ wingspan measured at the 2015 draft combine (Tankathon). He is drawn in Phoenix's road colors with his proposed look from the site's look sheet (not yet approved). It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
